s: Dine araba ubo v' seipim: "arbe nachal" haamur battora, hu min yadua hanniqra ken, vezeh simano: qaneh shello hu adom, vaapillu beodo yaroq — adam yotze bo yede chobato, lepi shessopo lihyot adom keshettaggia alayv hachamma, vealeh shello eno agol ella hu mashuk kenachal, upiv shel healeh, dehaynu chuddo, hu chaluq veeno asuy pegimot pegimot. Verob min zeh hu gadel al nachale mayim, ulekak niqra min zeh "arbe nachal", vaapillu miuto haggadel bammidbar ubeharim — gam ken hu kasher lemitzvat araba shebballulab, kevan sheyyesh bo kol simanim hallalu:

Veyesh min araba sheqqaneh shello hu adom vealeh shello mashuk kenachal, ella sheppi healeh eno chalaq vegam eno domeh lemassor (perush megera sheppegimoteha gedolot qetzat), ella yesh bo telamim qetannim ad meod kemo pi maggal qatan — vegam zeh kasher:

Abal yesh min echad domeh laaraba, abal qaneh shello eno adom vealeh shello agol upi healeh hu domeh lemassor, vezehu hanniqra "tzaptzapa", vehi pesula apillu bishat haddechaq kemo sheyyitbaer besiman trm"t. Vekol debarim ellu hen halaka lemosheh missinay:

Araba shenniqtam roshah, dehaynu shenniqtam rosh haetz atzmo shehealin gedelin bo — pesula, lepi sheen zeh hiddur. Ulekak tzarik lizzaher meod keshehabbaddin shel araba arukkin yoter midday verotzeh leqatztzetzan shello yeqatztzetzen berosham, ella lematta bemaqom shehen mitchabberim leheanap:

Nasheru rob aleha — pesula. Vetzarik lizzaher meod bedabar zeh, shellipamim nosherim al yede techibatan letok hallulab, vegam al yede ninua. Abal im lo neeqra raq miqtzat aleha — keshera. Umikkol maqom, lekattechilla en liqqach otah im epshar lo beqal limtzo acheret shelema shello nasheru mealeha kelum, shehashshelema hi mitzva min hammubchar:

Yabeshu rob aleha — pesula, sheen zeh hiddur. Vekamma shiur haybeshut? Mishshehilbinu penehem, abal im lo higgiu healin leshiur haybeshut ap al pi shekkebar komsha — hare zo keshera. Im niddaldelu rob healin venittequ mimmeqom chibburam baqqaneh, ap al pi shello nasheru lepi sheadayin hem mechubbarim qetzat, veken im nisdequ rob healin venechlequ lishnayim berob orek healeh — hare zeh keillu nasheru rob aleha upesula:
